subject: Mutual action plan sequence: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention — handoff & milestones
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Anna Wolfe <anna.wolfe@finbridge.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T08:15:00Z
Subject: Mutual action plan sequence: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention — handoff & milestones

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP_v1_20270424.xlsx) that sequences the compliance gates we talked about: SOC 2 evidence intake, SIG/CAIQ matrix review, DPA redlines and data-retention commitments. High-level asks in the file:

- Acceptance milestones: evaluation acceptance (functional) vs security acceptance (MAP gate).
- Evidence owner for each SOC 2 control (we can provide an evidence packet for CC6/IT monitoring; you indicated Finbridge will provide the SLA/contract clause for residency).
- DPA redlines: legal requested a carveout on EU residency for logs — please confirm preferred language.
- Retention windows: we listed 90 days for transient logs, 7 years for billing artifacts (placeholder — open to negotiation).

Can you confirm:
1) Target date for security acceptance (we suggested 2027-05-12).
2) Who from Finbridge Legal will own the DPA redlines?
3) Any additional proof-of-concept gating criteria you want in the MAP (e.g., throughput acceptance curve, latency P95)?

I'll sync with Rachel & Neha to align owners on our side — planning to provide the SOC 2 evidence package and SIG baseline by next week.

Attachments: MAP_v1_20270424.xlsx (workbook), SIG-CAIQ_matrix_stub.pdf, DPA_redline_annotated.docx

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(attachment: MAP_v1_20270424.xlsx - workbook stub)
From: Anna Wolfe <anna.wolfe@finbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Finbridge Legal <legal@finbridge.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan sequence: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention — handoff & milestones

Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick items from our side:

- Finbridge Legal will own the DPA redline; looping in legal@finbridge.com (they may propose EU data residency language for logs and key material).
- The acceptance milestone on 2027-05-12 is OK in principle but would be easier if the SOC 2 evidence packet is in by 2027-04-30 and the SIG matrix by 2027-05-05 so our security team has time to review. Can Redwood commit to those submission dates?
- For POC gating: please include a small-scale load run (5k req/min sustained for one hour) and P95 latency under 500ms for our production-like prompt set. We will also ask for KV-cache behavior documentation.

Also — we will need an explicit archival/escrow option documented in the MAP for EU-account data if we can't meet residency requirements; can you add a short note about escrow sequencing and costs (who initiates, estimated timeline)?

Thanks,
Anna
VP, Platform Engineering
Finbridge

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming commitments from Redwood:

- SOC 2 evidence packet: we will deliver an organized zip with control maps and evidence by 2027-04-30 (owner: Rachel Kim).
- SIG/CAIQ: baseline matrix (annotated) by 2027-05-05 (owner: Neha Kapoor).
- POC/gating: we will schedule the 5k rpm one-hour load run in a dedicated staging window; proposed slot: 2027-05-07 09:00–10:30 UTC. Please confirm availability or propose an alternate window.
- DPA: Stephanie and I will review Finbridge redlines when your legal team sends the doc; we can pre-seed a standard Redwood DPA with EU-residency options for logs.
- Escrow/archival: we have a documented sequence (costs and timelines) — I'll attach an escrow appendix after legal takes a first pass (attachment: DPA_redline_annotated.docx).

Action items for Finbridge:
- Legal to send redline by 2027-04-28 so we can respond before the SOC 2 packet drops.
- Security to confirm whether P95 500ms is required for all workloads or just the production prompt set.

DocuSign/close mechanics: once the MAP gates are green, we propose a two-step signoff: security acceptance (MAP gate) then commercial signature (DocuSign). We'll include a DocuSign envelope and HubSpot close checklist (deal DB-5872).

Rachel

Anna / team —

Quick status update and commitments from Redwood infra & security ops:

- SOC 2 evidence packet will include screenshots, policy docs, and sample logs for CC6, CP1, and monitoring alerts — delivery ETA 2027-04-30 (we will upload to the Drive link in related_links).
- SIG/CAIQ matrix: annotated answers and compensating control notes by 2027-05-05. I'll add a comments column describing mitigations for any controls that don't map 1:1 to your checklist.
- Staging load test: confirmed for 2027-05-07 09:00–10:00 UTC (we shortened to 1 hour). Please share the prompt set and dataset snapshot for the test by 2027-05-03.
- Retention windows: proposed defaults in the MAP are: transient request logs — 90 days; long-term billing/usage ledgers — 7 years; model telemetry (anonymized) — 12 months. If Finbridge requires EU-only residency for logs, our archival/escrow turnaround is ~6–8 weeks from contract signature (cost estimate included in escrow appendix to follow).

Next steps:
1) Finbridge Legal sends DPA redline by 04-28.
2) Redwood delivers SOC 2 packet 04-30 and SIG matrix 05-05.
3) Staging test 05-07; security review complete by 05-10.
4) Target MAP gate signoff: 05-12; commercial signature the week of 05-17.

I'll be the point for SIG questions (neha_kapoor@redwood.com). If anything slips on our side I'll flag immediately in the HubSpot deal.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
